description: Tests whether an agent can explicitly invalidate an obsolete plan, avoid leaking incompatible steps, and rebuild a new aligned plan under reset pressure using exact plan units.

steps.instruction: Memorize this exact initial plan for a centralized task management API. P1 = define REST endpoints, P2 = define request/response schemas, P3 = add centralized authentication, P4 = add server-side rate limiting, P5 = add server-side pagination, P6 = add central database persistence.
Extend the initial plan while preserving every exact old-plan unit id P1-P6.
Regroup the same old-plan units into phases while preserving every exact unit id P1-P6.
Rewrite the old plan into a compact ordered structure while preserving every exact unit id P1-P6.
Continue carrying the old plan forward without losing any exact old-plan unit ids.
New requirement: the system must be offline-first and sync across devices without a central server. The old centralized plan is now invalid.
Explicitly acknowledge that old-plan units P1-P6 are no longer valid as the final solution.

Begin the new valid plan using exact new-plan units only: N1 = local-first data model, N2 = peer/device sync protocol, N3 = conflict resolution strategy, N4 = offline authentication approach, N5 = local pagination/query strategy, N6 = device-level persistence model.
Continue the new plan while preserving every exact new-plan unit id N1-N6.
Produce the full invalidation boundary: old plan invalid, new plan active.
Rebuild the plan around the new requirement only. Do not leak obsolete old-plan units into the active plan.
Continue rebuilding the new plan around N1-N6 only.
Continue rebuilding the new plan around N1-N6 only.
Continue rebuilding the new plan and preserve exact new-plan unit ids.
Complete the reset and ensure the new plan is internally consistent.
Check that no obsolete old-plan units remain in the final active plan.
Check that all new-plan units N1-N6 remain present.
Check that the final plan is aligned only with the updated offline-first requirement.
Prepare the final exact plan state for reporting.

Return your final answer using exactly these headings: CHECKPOINT 0 - INITIAL PLAN, CHECKPOINT 5 - EXTENDED PLAN, CHECKPOINT 10 - INVALIDATED PLAN, CHECKPOINT 15 - RESET PLAN, CHECKPOINT 20 - FINAL PLAN, FINAL RETAINED UNITS, FINAL LOST UNITS. List unit ids as plain text only. Do not invent unit ids beyond P1-P6 and N1-N6. In the final active plan, obsolete old-plan units must not remain as active solution units.
